summary: Postinstall dropper fetches and executes remote binary from obfuscated Cloudflare Workers hosts
details: beaver-ui-layout@12.9.6 runs setup.js as a postinstall script that acts as an install-time dropper. The script selects a platform-specific asset and fetches bytes from one of several Cloudflare Workers hosts whose names are constructed at runtime by joining string fragments (e.g. ["oob-wor","ker.cf","99-9b3.wor","kers",".dev"].join("")) to evade static analysis, with a DNS-TXT covert-channel fallback via hosts such as tin.dl.well1.site. The fetched bytes are written to /var/tmp or %TEMP% under decoy filenames (.cache_<hex>, dotnet_diag_<hex>.exe), chmodded 0755, and launched detached via execFile. A 6-hour stamp file and DISABLE_TELEMETRY/DO_NOT_TRACK gates are used to throttle and mask execution. Installing this package causes the host to fetch and execute attacker-controlled code from mutable, anonymous infrastructure unrelated to the package's declared purpose.
